findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: crear_amigo_invisible · Private data: crear_amigo_invisible, crear_gastos, anadir_gasto, ver_resultados · Public sink: crear_amigo_invisible, crear_encuesta.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: crear_amigo_invisible · Private data: crear_amigo_invisible, crear_gastos, anadir_gasto, ver_resultados · Public sink: crear_amigo_invisible, crear_encuesta

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
